title: did anyone had this dream once and had it again but in the future?
content: I'll keep this quick because I don't remember my dreams a lot, but I had this dream once when I was 11 and had it again last night at 15 years old, but in the future. It is weird, but it is about Wario (yes, that Wario), and he is a pilot, but the only plane he flies is a small one. At the area where you prepare for liftoff as wario got off his plane he met this Chinese man (this took place at night) and the man and wario goes behind the bushes (I don't remember if they were behind the liftoff area I was 11 when I had this dream) behind the bushes was a big warehouse I don't remember a lot from this dream remember I was 11 when I had this dream. Still, one thing that I remember inside the warehouse was a machine, and Wario put a coin in the machine, and it dispensed this blue bag full of Legos, then I woke up from my dream. But yesterday I had a similar dream where Wario is still a pilot and he tries to find this warehouse again, but when Wario finds it, it is abandoned, and Wario sees this anthropomorphic orange cat with a Mexican accent and Wario asks the cat what happened to this place the cat said that it was abandoned for years (I think this new dream was set like 5 years after my old dream) then I woke up. What do you think about this, and did anyone have a similar dream like this, and what does it all mean?
